feedback.problem:
For the matrix
$V=[\begin{aligned}j & 1 & 3i \\ 2 & k & 5 \\ 4 & j & k\end{aligned}],$
find the minor ${M}_{21}$ of the element ${v}_{21}.$

${M}_{21}=${{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${v}_{21},$ we remove the second row and first column:

$$
V=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 1 & 3i \\ 2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & j & k\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${v}_{21}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{21} & =det[\begin{aligned}1 & 3i \\ j & k\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 3i \\ j & k\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot k-(3i)\cdot j \\  & =k-3ij.\end{aligned}
$$
